subject: Re: BrightGrid onsite demo — timing, badging, and logistics
messages:
From: Aparna Shah <aparna@brightgrid.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: demo@brightgrid.com, james.evans@brightgrid.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: BrightGrid visit — request to book an onsite demo (Jun 24–25)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week — the BrightGrid team is excited to see Redwood’s runtime in person. We’re hoping to bring a small delegation (3–4 people) for a hands-on demo and Q&A. Proposed windows: Thu, Jun 24 between 9:00–11:00 PT or Fri, Jun 25 between 9:00–12:00 PT. Our priority is a 90–120 minute block with a short run-through of integration patterns and a short “ops” breakout.

We can sign an NDA ahead of time — I attached our standard mutual NDA for your legal team to review. Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm badging/visitor process? We’ll have two team members who need escorting.
- Any preferred AV setup or laptop/kiosk rules?

Happy to adjust times if you have conflicts. James (cc’d) will be the exec lead attending.

Thanks,
Aparna
Aparna Shah
Senior Product Manager, BrightGrid
aparna@brightgrid.com

Attachment: BrightGrid_NDA_v3.pdf (PDF)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Aparna Shah <aparna@brightgrid.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGrid visit — request to book an onsite demo (Jun 24–25)

Hi Aparna — great to hear from you and we’d love to host BrightGrid. Thanks for the NDA.

A few quick notes:
- Badging: please send full legal names + government ID type (passport or driver’s license) for anyone who needs building access. We’ll issue a one-day visitor badge and a host escort is required while on floors 4–6.
- Parking: we can provide a temporary permit for the visitor lot (I’ll attach instructions and permit once the date is confirmed).
- AV: Kimberly will confirm room setup; we usually offer a room with HDMI + USB-C dongles and a small breakout table for hands-on work.
- Food: we typically order boxed lunches for demo days — any dietary restrictions?

Scheduling: Thurs 9–11 PT conflicts on our side (exec all-hands). Would you be able to move to Fri, Jun 25 morning? If not, we can do Thu afternoon 1:00–3:00 PT as a fallback.

I’ve looped in Kimberly (ops), Marcus (hosting) and Stephanie (logistics/catering). I’ll draft a calendar invite once we lock time.

Onward,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0124

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Aparna Shah <aparna@brightgrid.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGrid visit — AV/room + floor map

Thanks Vanessa — quick ops note from my side:
- Room: reserving Conference Room 5A (capacity 12) as primary and 5B as overflow in case you want separate breakout for the ops team. Room 5A has ceiling mic and dual-screen; we’ll provide HDMI and a USB-C dongle.
- Network: guest VLAN access available; please let us know if you need static IPs or special ports open (we can request from infra).
- Floor map: attaching the AV layout for floor 5 and the closest loading/visitor entrance.

If BrightGrid plans to bring hardware that needs power racks or extra table space, tell us now so we can reconfigure the room.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Facilities Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment: Floor5_AV_map.png (PNG)

From: James Evans <james.evans@brightgrid.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Aparna Shah <aparna@brightgrid.com>
Cc: demo@brightgrid.com, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 07:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightGrid visit — timing update (flight delay)

Hi all — quick update from our side: my inbound flight on Thu has been delayed and it now arrives late evening, so the team would prefer to shift to Fri morning (Jun 25) if that still works. Aparna just completed the DocuSign NDA — link below — and attached the signed copy for your records.

> On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 10:03 AM vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai wrote:
> > Scheduling: Thurs 9–11 PT conflicts on our side (exec all-hands). Would you be able to move to Fri, Jun 25 morning? If not, we can do Thu afternoon 1:00–3:00 PT as a fallback.

We can do Fri, Jun 25 09:30–11:30 PT. Also: one of our attendees has a dietary restriction (gluten-free) and another is vegetarian.

Thanks — attaching the signed NDA here.
James
James Evans
Head of Integrations, BrightGrid
james.evans@brightgrid.com

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: James Evans <james.evans@brightgrid.com>, Aparna Shah <aparna@brightgrid.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Fri Jun 25 09:30–11:30 PT — BrightGrid onsite (badging + parking)

All — confirmed for Fri, Jun 25, 09:30–11:30 PT. Notes and next steps: 
- Calendar: invite sent (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=brightgrid-demo-20270625). Please accept.
- Host/Escorts: Marcus will meet you in the lobby at 09:15 and escort to Floor 5. Stephanie will handle badges and boxed lunches.
- Badging: please reply to this thread with full legal names and ID type (passport or driver’s license) for each visitor. We need that by EOD Thu to have badges ready.
- Parking: Attached is a temporary parking permit PDF and drop-off instructions — park in Visitor Lot C and display the permit on the dash.
- Catering/dietary: Noted — we’ll provide gluten-free and vegetarian boxed lunches. If there are additional restrictions, flag them now.
- AV/hardware: Kimberly confirmed Room 5A; if you’re bringing any bulky hardware let Marcus know and we’ll reserve extra table space.

Looking forward to hosting your team.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: Visitor_Parking_Permit.pdf (PDF)
